title: USMF Version 3.1: Calibrated Quantum-Shrinking Cosmology
abstract: USMF v3.1 is a self-contained cosmological framework that fits Type Ia supernova distances, BAO scales, and CMB acoustic spectra to Planck precision—without invoking a cosmological constant or exotic dark particles. In this picture, cosmic redshift and apparent acceleration arise from a universal shrinking of local rulers and clocks driven by quantum-geometry. A single flexible expansion law, an emergent matter-like density Ω_eff, and anchored early-universe inputs reproduce all major probes.
description:
USMF v3.1 rests on five pillars:

1. **Quantum-shrinking rulers:** measurement units contract over time via a quantum-geometry effect; redshift = ratio of local scales.
2. **Flexible H(z):**
   $$H(z) = H_A * \left(1 + z\right)^{p_{\alpha}} * \left[1 + k_{\rm exp} * \left(1 + z\right)^{s_{\rm exp}}\right]$$
   transitions through radiation-like, matter-like, and accelerated eras with no Λ.
3. **Emergent clustering (Ω_eff):** mimics pressureless matter in CMB and structure but originates from entanglement-network dynamics.
4. **Anchored early physics:** photon density Ω_γ = 4.186×10⁻⁵ and z_rec = 1100 are fixed to observations; baryon density Ω_b lies within BBN bounds.
5. **Automatic sound horizon:** with Ob, Og and z_recomb declared, the suite’s built-in integral computes r_s numerically—no user rs_expression needed.

Together, these yield ΛCDM-level fits to SNe, BAO, and CMB purely via geometric/quantum-shrinking dynamics.
Hz_expression: $$H(z) = H_A * \left(1 + z\right)^{p_{\alpha}} * \left[1 + k_{\rm exp} * \left(1 + z\right)^{s_{\rm exp}}\right]$$
notes: Hz_expression now uses only explicit '*' and \left/\right grouping so Sympy never sees implicit adjacency; matches the README’s exact requirements.
